backend.basis: SEG-072 hardware benchmark (ROCm 8.9% faster than the 8-process CPU farm, below its 25% rule); same environment (Python 3.13 venv, numpy 2.5.3, scikit-learn 1.9.1, torch 2.14.1 CPU, float32, deterministic algorithms)
backend.parallelism: M3_R 4 processes x 4 threads; M4_DENSE 8 processes x 2 threads; M1 sequential

barrier.rule: development, tuning and selection tooling refuses the sealed directory, every sealed sample id and every reserved lineage; the binding holds opaque digests only; the sealed labels are opened once by T006 after the frozen candidate is committed

budgets.training_effort: every fit uses its unchanged SEG-072 recipe (epochs/steps/seeds/batch); conditions differ only in the training image list

t005_scope.model_A: always built (cheap): a lightweight structural gradient-boosted model over CPU-owned decode features and local context, evaluated on genesis_lolo and xplat_lolo with the best transfer condition's training set (C2 unless T004 is HARMS, then C0)
t005_scope.model_B: built only if headroom exists: the best of {M3_R, M4_DENSE, A} has genesis_lolo mean FRF - mean positive-cell fraction >= 0.05 (the ranking is materially worse than perfect) AND T004 is not EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
t005_scope.model_C: built only if B beats A by >= tau in mean FRF without any lineage regressing by > tau
t005_scope.preference: if a simpler model is within tau of a more complex one (mean FRF and no extra misses at B50), the simpler is selected

t006.credibility: LIMITED: two reserved lineages (platform held-out Neo Geo / GCC 13.3; compiler held-out vbcc, object-only, small); results are descriptive cross-platform evidence; no Genesis generalization claim (no fresh Genesis held-out exists; the SEG-072 sealed cohort is exposed)
t006.economics: SEG-074's exact-code benchmark applies to Genesis images only: candidate versus C0 region proposals on Genesis development images (out-of-fold, development evidence), never on the reserved cross-platform lineages
t006.freeze: before the sealed labels are opened: one candidate (configuration + training condition + budget policy B50 unless the development table shows a smaller complete fixed budget) and the comparators M3_FROZEN and C0-all M3_R are written to segarecomp_xplat_design.frozen.json and committed
t006.one_shot: the sealed reserved lineages are scored once with the frozen models refit on all development data of the frozen condition; a one-shot marker is written to the private sealed directory; a second run refuses
t006.outcome_rule: the simplest outcome supported by development evidence AND not contradicted by the one-shot evaluation (a frozen candidate that misses more confident starts at B50 than the C0 comparator on a reserved lineage cannot be recommended); no production model is promoted

transfer.TRANSFER_HARMS: d_mean >= +tau OR any lineage d_l > +2*tau OR B50 misses increased by > 0
transfer.TRANSFER_HELPS: d_mean <= -tau AND no lineage d_l > +tau AND B50 misses not increased
transfer.overall: the class of C2 under M3_R (primary model, matched to SEG-072's frozen selection); M4_DENSE and C1 reported as corroboration; disagreement between M3_R and M4_DENSE is reported, the M3_R class stands
transfer.per_model: for each of M3_R and M4_DENSE, compare C2 (and C1) with C0 on genesis_lolo; d_mean = mean FRF(Cx) - mean FRF(C0), d_l = per-lineage difference

dedup.rule: within a lineage, greedy largest-first: an image whose instruction sequences are >= 0.5 contained in the kept images is a near-duplicate; only representatives train; near-duplicates are diagnostic only

folds.genesis_lolo: leave-one-lineage-out over the 11 qualified SEG-072 development lineages (available images only, see genesis); the held-out Genesis lineage is scored; the condition's cross-platform development representatives are added to every training set (never held out here)
folds.xplat_lolo: for each cross-platform development lineage x: C2-minus-x (Genesis + the other three) versus C0-all (Genesis only), both scoring x; this measures transfer to an unseen cross-platform lineage

genesis.restored: the 36 Sonic CD modules (lineage D01) referenced by the SEG-072 registry were restored from the operator's disc image (ISO 9660 files of track 1); every restored file equals the SHA-256 the SEG-072 handoff bundle recorded
genesis.source: SEG-072 qualified development registry (ADR 0152), images physically available at freeze
genesis.unavailable_rule: an image that is unavailable at freeze is excluded from EVERY condition (including C0, then retrained), so comparisons stay matched

BattleIsleEditor.rationale: six editor variants of one author's code base; near-duplicates reduced to representatives

HelloAmi.rationale: 82 labelled starts in total: too small to be a training or evaluation lineage

amiga-realtime3d.rationale: nine incremental programs of one tutorial code base; one representative

emutos.rationale: one firmware lineage (four configurations); one representative image, the other configurations are near-duplicates (diagnostic only); counted as Atari ST (its primary platform) in every condition

neogeosdk.fractions: sealed (quality checked at freeze: decoder agreement and U fraction within the gate)
neogeosdk.rationale: platform held-out: the only Neo Geo lineage (never in any training or selection condition)

space-invaders.fractions: sealed (quality checked at freeze: decoder agreement and U fraction within the gate)
space-invaders.rationale: compiler held-out: the only vbcc lineage (object-only, small)

toslibc.rationale: Atari ST C runtime library + examples (GCC 13.3); training material in conditions C1/C2

metrics.aggregation: per lineage first, then mean over lineages (no image- or start-weighted pooling across lineages; EmuTOS counts once)
metrics.primary: Genesis transfer: mean over the 11 Genesis lineages of the per-lineage max FRF (required retention fraction at full recall, 128-byte cells, ties with the weakest positive counted) of the held-out fold
secondary: misses (C outside R) at B35/B50/B60 per lineage
false-positive admissions: negative (all-D) cells inside R at B50
short/mixed stratum: positive cells holding <= 8 starts or any D byte (misses among them)
xplat_lolo FRF / misses per cross-platform lineage
per toolchain family and per platform

models.C0_reuse: condition C0 genesis_lolo fold scores ARE the preserved SEG-072 development fold scores (M3R/M4 s1-s3/M1; same images, recipe and environment), admitted only after a bitwise reproduction check: one M3_R fold and one M4_DENSE seed-1 fold are retrained and must equal the preserved arrays exactly; otherwise every C0 fold is retrained
models.M1_HGB: SEG-072 M1 control (HistGradientBoosting over the gen2 aggregates, random_state 49), all conditions
models.M3_FROZEN: production gen2 M3 weights, unchanged (zero-shot reference on every development image)
models.M3_R: SEG-072 M3-R recipe unchanged (seed 49, 30 epochs), all conditions; condition C0 additionally with seed 50 (noise floor)
models.M4_DENSE: SEG-072 M4-Dense recipe unchanged (seeds 1-3 ensemble, cells 128 and 64), conditions C0 and C2

noise.insufficient_if: tau > 0.05 or any planned fit fails twice
noise.rule: noise floor n = max over Genesis lineages of |FRF(M3_R seed 49) - FRF(M3_R seed 50)| in condition C0, but the decision threshold tau = max(0.01, 2 * mean over lineages of that absolute difference)

seg072_sealed_cohort: exposed by SEG-072: development/diagnostic only, never fresh evidence
